about: Hand-written expectations for #86 (tools/qualify_lag_classes.py). Invented incidents: 30 pass Received > Logged at the same time (a busy path of zero lag), 5 pass Logged > Closed after 30 hours, 2 pass Received > Closed after 324 hours (a rare slow path). With the classes up to 24 h, 24 h to 7 d and over 7 d, the busy path is drawn in the neutral grey, the 30-hour path in the first blue and the rare slow path in the darker blue. Never read by product code.
